description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are not protected.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for unencrypted data storage, missing encryption controls, inadequate access controls on stored data, lack of integrity verification mechanisms, and insufficient availability protections for data at rest.
